note: Expected results for a blockstate file. 'meta' is the block metadata, 'resolved' are the properties a StateResolver supplies, 'properties' is the full decoded state, 'parts' are the models drawn in order. 'bta' is the same rotation as BTA renderAttached quarter turns [rotX, rotY, rotZ] = [-x/90, -y/90, 0] mod 4 (derived from the maths, to confirm in game).
